description: Connect KDAN PDF to ChatGPT to prepare PDFs before you send them out. Ask ChatGPT to compare versions, remove selected pages, redact sensitive details, compress large files, or set and update PDF passwords. It helps keep proposals, reports, contracts, and other important documents ready before you share them with clients or teammates.

defaultPrompt: Compare these two PDF versions and show me what changed
Redact my phone number and address from this PDF
Compress this PDF and tell me how much smaller it got
